Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 48

“Established in yoga, perform your actions abandoning attachment, Dhananjaya, remaining the same in success and failure. Evenness of mind is called yoga.”

Krishna offers his own definition, and it is startlingly plain — yoga is samatva, evenness. Not posture, not withdrawal, but a level attitude carried into the middle of activity.
